dropzone.title: Drag & Drop Lockfile for Instant Analysis
dropzone.subtitle: We never store your source code. Only package names and versions are safely analyzed at the edge.
dropzone.dropInstruction: Drop composer.lock, package-lock.json, CycloneDX (bom.json), or WP Site Health (.txt) here
dropzone.dropInstructionOr: or click to select file / paste via 'WordPress Site Info Diagnosis' above

dropzone.scanningStep1: Parsing manifest / site info... ({{count}} packages detected)
dropzone.wpModalTitle: WordPress Site Info Diagnosis (No Plugin Required)
dropzone.wpModalSubtitle: Simply copy and paste WordPress's built-in 'Site Health Info' to immediately diagnose vulnerabilities across Core, PHP, all plugins, and themes.
dropzone.wpHowToTitle: 📍 How to Get Site Health Info from WordPress Admin (30 sec)
dropzone.wpStep1: 1. Open 'Tools' > 'Site Health' in your WordPress Admin sidebar.
dropzone.wpStep2: 2. Click the 'Info' tab at the top of the screen.
dropzone.wpStep3: 3. Click the 'Copy site info to clipboard' button.
dropzone.wpStep4: 4. Paste the text directly into the box below (Ctrl+V / ⌘+V) and click 'Run Diagnosis'.
dropzone.wpPrivacyNote: * Passwords, posts, and source code are not included. Server file paths are discarded in your browser—only package names and versions are checked.
dropzone.wpPasteLabel: Paste your WordPress Site Health Info text here
dropzone.wpEmptyError: Please paste your WordPress Site Health Info text.
dropzone.wpInvalidFormatError: WordPress Site Health format (e.g. ### wp-core ###) was not found. Please paste the text copied via the 'Copy site info to clipboard' button.
dropzone.scopeDisclaimerLine1: * This diagnosis covers the application layer (WordPress Core, plugins, themes, and PHP).
dropzone.scopeDisclaimerLine2: Infrastructure vulnerabilities (OS, web servers, etc.) are outside the scope of this scan.
